title: Elective 9 — Test
src: Online Medical & Dental Resources and Search Engines

mcqs.q: Why are online resources important for dental education?
opts: They give access to updated knowledge, support EBP and continuing education
mcqs.explain: Online resources provide access to updated knowledge, evidence-based practice, clinical decision-making support and continuing-education opportunities.

mcqs.q: Cochrane Oral Health is best known for providing:
mcqs.explain: Cochrane Oral Health provides systematic reviews for evidence-based decision-making, covering oral-health-related interventions.

mcqs.q: The ADA Center for Evidence-Based Dentistry offers:
opts: Clinical guidelines, systematic reviews and primary studies
mcqs.explain: The ADA Center for Evidence-Based Dentistry offers clinical guidelines, systematic reviews and primary studies.

mcqs.q: Which is described as the MOST comprehensive database for biomedical and dental literature?
mcqs.explain: PubMed is the most comprehensive database for biomedical and dental literature, with over 20 million citations and free MEDLINE access.

mcqs.q: DOSS (Dentistry and Oral Sciences Source) provides:
opts: Full-text access covering all facets of dentistry
mcqs.explain: DOSS covers all facets of dentistry with full-text access to top dental journals.

mcqs.q: EMBASE has a particularly strong focus on:
mcqs.explain: EMBASE is a comprehensive biomedical database with a strong focus on drug trials, pharmacology and international research.

mcqs.q: Dentaltown is best described as:
opts: A community-driven platform with specialties like paediatric dentistry and endodontics
mcqs.explain: Dentaltown is a community-driven platform with specialties such as paediatric dentistry and endodontics.

mcqs.q: The Colgate Oral Health Network offers:
opts: 200+ free CE credits via webinars (ADA CERP-recognized)
mcqs.explain: Colgate Oral Health Network offers over 200 free CE credits via webinars and articles, and is an ADA CERP-recognized provider.

mcqs.q: DentalCare.com provides:
opts: 150+ free CE resources with interactive modules and patient-education tools
mcqs.explain: DentalCare.com gives free access to 150+ CE resources, interactive teaching modules and patient-education tools.

mcqs.q: Which are comprehensive interdisciplinary RESEARCH databases?
mcqs.explain: Comprehensive research databases include Scopus and Web of Science (interdisciplinary), plus the Joanna Briggs Institute EBP Database.

mcqs.q: The Joanna Briggs Institute EBP Database provides:
opts: Evidence summaries and best-practice information sheets
mcqs.explain: The Joanna Briggs Institute EBP Database provides evidence summaries and best-practice information sheets.

mcqs.q: The CDC Oral Health Division mainly provides:
opts: Guidelines on infection control and public health programs
mcqs.explain: Among government resources, the CDC Oral Health Division provides guidelines on infection control and public health programs.

mcqs.q: The r/Dentistry subreddit is an example of which resource category?
mcqs.explain: The Dentistry subreddit (r/Dentistry) is a community-based platform with 70,000+ members sharing experiences and peer discussions.

mcqs.q: Google Scholar provides free access to:
opts: Scholarly articles, theses and technical reports
mcqs.explain: Google Scholar is an advanced search engine giving free access to scholarly articles, theses and technical reports.

mcqs.q: Trip Pro is a search engine focused on:
opts: Evidence-based healthcare resources, guidelines and systematic reviews
mcqs.explain: Trip Pro provides evidence-based healthcare resources, including guidelines and systematic reviews.

mcqs.q: Web of Science is notable for its powerful combination of:
mcqs.explain: Web of Science combines citation indexing with web technology for in-depth dental research.

mcqs.q: Which is an ADVANTAGE of online resources?
opts: 24/7 access to updated information and a global professional community
They are only available once a year
mcqs.explain: Advantages include 24/7 access, support for evidence-based decisions, lifelong learning via CE, and access to a global community of dental professionals.

mcqs.q: Which is a CHALLENGE of using online resources?
opts: Information overload and identifying trustworthy sources
mcqs.explain: Challenges include information overload, identifying trustworthy sources, and time management in navigating multiple platforms.

mcqs.q: A recommended BEST PRACTICE for using online resources is to:
opts: Always verify the credibility of sources and use trusted platforms
mcqs.explain: Best practice: always verify source credibility, use trusted platforms (PubMed, Cochrane, ADA), combine specialty and general databases, and stay updated with CE.

mcqs.q: The Academy of General Dentistry (AGD) primarily offers:
opts: Blogs, podcasts and CE opportunities tailored to general dentists
mcqs.explain: The Academy of General Dentistry (AGD) provides blogs, podcasts and CE opportunities tailored to general dentists.

mcqs.q: 'Delivering Better Oral Health' is an institutional resource providing:
opts: Essential guidelines for prevention in dentistry
mcqs.explain: Delivering Better Oral Health provides essential guidelines for prevention in dentistry.

saqs.q: Why are online resources needed in dental education?
saqs.a: They provide access to updated knowledge, support evidence-based practice and clinical decision-making, and create continuing-education opportunities.
Cochrane Oral Health (systematic reviews of oral-health interventions) and the ADA Center for Evidence-Based Dentistry (clinical guidelines, systematic reviews and primary studies).

saqs.q: List the major dentistry databases and their strengths.
saqs.a: PubMed — most comprehensive (20M+ citations, free MEDLINE). DOSS — all facets of dentistry, full-text journals. EMBASE — biomedical, strong on drug trials/international research.
Colgate Oral Health Network (200+ free CE credits, ADA CERP-recognized) and DentalCare.com (150+ free CE resources with interactive modules).

saqs.q: List the advanced search engines for dental research.
saqs.a: Google Scholar, Web of Science, Scopus, and Trip Pro.

saqs.q: List the advantages of online resources.
saqs.a: 24/7 access to updated information, support for evidence-based clinical decisions, lifelong learning via CE, and access to a global community of dental professionals.

saqs.q: List the challenges and best practices in using online resources.
saqs.a: Challenges: information overload, identifying trustworthy sources, time management. Best practices: verify credibility, use trusted platforms (PubMed, Cochrane, ADA), combine specialty + general databases, stay updated with CE, and engage professional communities.
